The plate is about 330 px wide in the image. If it is a 26 cm dinner plate, that works out to roughly 0.08 cm per pixel.

The food is a single sausage-like item, about 150 px long and 55 px wide. That is roughly 12 cm by 4.5 cm. Treating it as a cylinder with a 4 cm diameter, the volume is about 3.14 × 4 × 12 ≈ 150 cm³, which would weigh about 150 g. A real sausage is probably thinner than that, closer to 3.5 cm across, which gives about 115 g. I'll estimate 110 g.

At about 2.7 kcal/g for a typical sausage, 110 g comes to roughly 300 kcal.
